test_vectors.name: roots_record_category_depth_and_the_exact_original_borrow
test_vectors.vector: All six root categories, surrounding whitespace, duplicate keys, nested containers and preserved escape/exponent spelling
test_vectors.expected: Correct FragmentKind, maximum simultaneously open containers and identical input slice pointer and contents

test_vectors.name: only_the_four_json_whitespace_bytes_are_ignored
test_vectors.vector: Space, TAB, LF and CR in grammar positions; controls, DEL, BOM, NBSP and Unicode line separators outside strings
test_vectors.expected: Only JSON whitespace ignored; other bytes rejected outside strings and valid Unicode preserved inside strings

test_vectors.name: incomplete_values_report_eof_at_the_input_end
test_vectors.vector: Empty input, whitespace, partial literals, signs, fractions, exponents, strings, escapes, surrogate pairs and containers
test_vectors.expected: Encode/UnexpectedEof with byte_offset equal to the supplied input length

test_vectors.name: malformed_container_grammar_has_exact_offsets
test_vectors.vector: Mismatched closes, missing values, trailing/doubled commas, missing separators/colons, unquoted keys and comments
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InvalidSyntax at the first invalid grammar byte

test_vectors.name: complete_roots_reject_second_values_and_trailing_garbage
test_vectors.vector: Adjacent or whitespace-separated roots, stray delimiters, comments and trailing nonwhitespace
test_vectors.expected: Encode/TrailingContent at the first byte following the completed value and allowed whitespace

test_vectors.name: literal_spelling_is_case_sensitive_and_exact
test_vectors.vector: Incorrect case and misspellings of null, true and false, including nested literals
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InvalidSyntax at the mismatching byte

test_vectors.name: number_vectors_preserve_arbitrary_precision_and_exponents
test_vectors.vector: Signed zero, fractions, signed/padded exponents, integers beyond u128 and very large exponents; 90 deterministic sign/integer/fraction/exponent combinations at root and in arrays
test_vectors.expected: Valid grammar accepted without machine numeric conversion and exact spelling preserved

test_vectors.name: invalid_number_grammar_identifies_the_first_bad_byte
test_vectors.vector: Leading plus/zeros, NaN, Infinity, repeated signs, missing fraction/exponent digits, hexadecimal, underscores and illegal suffixes
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InvalidNumber at the first invalid number byte

test_vectors.name: string_escapes_are_legal_and_unescaped_controls_are_rejected
test_vectors.vector: All 128 ASCII bytes as unescaped string content, all legal short escapes, illegal escapes and malformed hexadecimal digits
test_vectors.expected: Exact ControlCharInString, InvalidEscape, UnexpectedEof or TrailingContent diagnostics; legal contents accepted

test_vectors.name: utf8_validation_rejects_invalid_scalars_and_truncated_sequences
test_vectors.vector: All single bytes 0x80 through 0xFF, overlong encodings, UTF-8 surrogate encodings, out-of-range scalars, truncated sequences and Unicode encoding-width boundaries
test_vectors.expected: Encode/InvalidUtf8 at valid_up_to for malformed UTF-8; valid boundary scalars fit exact decoded byte budgets

test_vectors.name: surrogate_pairs_cover_both_extremes_and_reject_unpaired_units
test_vectors.vector: U+10000, emoji, U+10FFFF, mixed-case pairs, standalone high/low surrogates, invalid second units and malformed low-unit hexadecimal digits
test_vectors.expected: Pairs accepted; unpaired units yield LoneSurrogate; malformed hex yields InvalidEscape with precise fragment offsets

test_vectors.name: decoded_byte_limits_use_codepoint_width_instead_of_escape_spelling
test_vectors.vector: Empty string, escaped UTF-8 width boundaries, surrogate pairs, eight short escapes and literal/escaped a plus accented text plus CJK plus emoji
test_vectors.expected: Inclusive decoded UTF-8 byte budgets of zero through ten; one-byte-short budgets fail with BudgetExhausted

test_vectors.name: escaped_controls_each_decode_to_one_byte_and_keys_share_string_limits
test_vectors.vector: All 32 escaped controls, empty keys/values, escaped ASCII keys and surrogate-pair keys
test_vectors.expected: Controls cost one decoded byte; property names obey the same decoded string limits as values

test_vectors.name: whole_input_budget_includes_all_whitespace_and_is_inclusive
test_vectors.vector: Scalars, escaped strings and containers at exact and one-byte-short output limits; zero budget and invalid UTF-8 beyond that budget
test_vectors.expected: Whole input size checked before parsing; exact limits accepted and excess size yields PayloadTooLarge

test_vectors.name: number_length_counts_sign_fraction_and_exponent_but_not_whitespace
test_vectors.vector: 0, -0 and 12.30E-04 at exact and short token budgets; nested numbers; zero budget; a 1025-digit integer
test_vectors.expected: Every number token byte counted once, whitespace excluded, first excess byte reported and arbitrary precision accepted when budget permits

test_vectors.name: depth_limits_are_relative_inclusive_and_independent_of_sibling_count
test_vectors.vector: Scalars at depth zero, root containers, sibling containers and depth-two/depth-three objects and arrays
test_vectors.expected: Scalars have depth zero; maximum open container count determines depth; excess opener yields DepthLimitExceeded

test_vectors.name: full_u16_depth_uses_heap_frames_without_host_stack_recursion
test_vectors.vector: 65535 nested arrays and a second vector with one additional opener
test_vectors.expected: Full u16 depth accepted iteratively; extra depth rejected at offset 65535 before another frame allocation

test_vectors.name: container_counts_are_per_container_and_duplicate_keys_are_legal

test_vectors.expected: Independent inclusive counts, duplicates allowed and children counted only once in their parent

test_vectors.name: counter_overflow_boundaries_fail_without_wrapping_or_advancing

test_vectors.name: every_proper_prefix_of_a_container_document_is_rejected

test_vectors.expected: UnexpectedEof at each prefix length; only the complete document accepted

test_vectors.name: emit_preserves_root_bytes_and_excludes_a_preexisting_sink_prefix

test_vectors.name: emit_output_budget_includes_the_parent_comma_and_closing_delimiter

test_vectors.name: emit_revalidates_every_resource_under_the_writers_limits
